question: Can a maximum-minimum-view-angle reference-only vacancy fill preserve a three-reference descriptor memory while evaluating exactly two unique query observations from the source-scarce ninth family?

selection.base_memory: Preserve the two positive-marginal reference views and two unique query views selected by the frozen source gate.
selection.reference_vacancy_fill: From the remaining source-admitted reference views, add exactly one view that maximizes its minimum camera-to-target angular separation from the two preserved references; ties use more visible target vertices, larger short-side fraction, higher depth-visible ratio, then earlier frame.
selection.query_policy: Do not duplicate, synthesize or replace a query observation. Evaluate exactly the two source-admitted unique query frames.

forbidden_after_freeze: change the two preserved reference views or either unique query view
change the maximum-minimum-angle vacancy rule or deterministic ties
open RGB or call a model before the cohort is materialized
count this post-source mechanism design as fresh confirmation
duplicate a query row to increase the denominator
